blockers: Iterate systemd directory entries with explicit entry-count and name-length bounds, avoiding list materialization and emitting sanitized deterministic overflow evidence.
Anchor the complete root-to-target ancestor chain with held directory descriptors or equivalent no-symlink resolution so ancestors cannot be swapped between trust checks and content opens.

issues.title: Systemd inventory enumeration is unbounded
issues.details: list(os.scandir()) allows large unrelated directories or names to consume unbounded memory/time before verification can produce evidence.

issues.title: Ancestor trust checks can race before fd-relative opens
issues.details: Path-based lstat checks and later opens do not hold the validated ancestor chain; O_NOFOLLOW protects only the final component.

issues.title: Verifier tests are not discoverable by standard unittest discovery
issues.details: The hyphenated test filename yields zero discovered tests, risking CI configurations that silently skip coverage.
